propositions: Twenty-one pure-intercept routes lack committed help artifacts and do not appear in overview help or respond to `rebar help <command>` correctly
Identity child parsers disable help actions causing `rebar identity create --help` to reach top-level usage and exit with error
Help discovery predicate must be exactly `not route.hidden and not route.retired` across four help-backed census sites without adding route metadata
Generated CLI reference must consume committed-artifact bytes via `subcommand_help()` for every documented route instead of independent rendering
Top-level help pre-scan must cover every live visible route while preserving exact nested-intercept set of audit, config, identity, llm, prompt, criteria, and workflow for nonleading child help
Comments and docstrings claiming intercept routes lack committed help must be corrected to reflect that ADR 0100 establishes registry-backed committed artifacts as authoritative
